limitations.note: The rewrite matches the corrected waveform at the default settings but changes pulse widths for parameter overrides: for a 12-cycle period, it holds the output high for six cycles instead of the five preserved by the minimal fix.
The override test encoded the rewrite’s new half-period pulse widths, so it could catch the original default-case bug but not the change in behavior under parameter overrides.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The recursive cleanup command caused the tool to reject the entire simulation invocation before it ran, requiring a retry.
